about: The only place where effect colours have hex values. Effect files name roles only. 'from' says whose value it is: mustafa = his decision; art-lead = the Art lead's working value (instruction of 2026-11-14); board-v7 = the Art lead's proposal on the VFX drawing board v7; derived = computed by Shamble VFX from those values with the board's own formula; assumed = Shamble VFX's guess, waiting for a decision.
